Metadata.title: Medilog — Smart Medical Records Platform
Metadata.description: Medilog is a smart medical records platform for managing patient files, appointments, visits, and prescriptions securely.

Home.title: Everything about your patient, in one place.
Home.description: Medilog is a smart medical platform that helps doctors and clinics manage records, appointments, visits, and prescriptions with ease and confidence.
Home.proof: Trusted by modern doctors and clinics
Home.featuresDescription: Medilog gives you a clearer view and better control over every part of the patient journey.

featuresList.title: Organized records
featuresList.description: Keep medical history, diagnoses, and prescriptions in one clear profile.

featuresList.title: Effortless scheduling
featuresList.description: Organize your calendar and keep a quick view of every patient's visit.

featuresList.title: Data-led decisions
featuresList.description: Track your clinic activity and uncover insights that help you grow.

featuresList.title: One connected team
featuresList.description: Give your team the right tools for a smoother care experience.

Home.workflowDescription: From the first appointment to follow-up, every step is organized so you can focus on what matters.

workflow.title: Add patient details
workflow.description: Create an organized medical profile in seconds.

workflow.title: Record the visit
workflow.description: Document diagnoses, prescriptions, and notes in one place.

workflow.title: Track progress
workflow.description: Return to a clear timeline and make better decisions.

Home.securityTitle: Your patients' data is always protected
Home.securityDescription: Privacy and security are at the heart of the experience, so you can work with confidence.
securityPoints: A timeline that's easy to review
Home.storyEyebrow: Real experiences, even when starting small
Home.storyTitle: Made for the busy clinic day
Home.storyDescription: Every detail in Medilog is designed to make your day calmer and give you more time to focus on patients.

testimonials.quote: I can see the patient's full history before the visit starts, without searching through scattered files.
testimonials.name: Dr. Sarah Khaled

testimonials.quote: Organizing appointments and daily follow-ups saved our team hours of calls and coordination.
testimonials.name: Mona Ali

testimonials.quote: The interface is clear and fast, and sensitive information stays visible only to the right person.
testimonials.name: Dr. Omar Hassan

Home.ctaDescription: Organize your day, understand your data, and deliver better care with Medilog.

organized-records.title: One clear patient record
organized-records.description: Keep medical history, diagnoses, prescriptions, vital signs, and visit notes together in a chronological, accessible patient profile.

benefits.title: Complete history
benefits.description: Review prior visits and findings before the next appointment.

benefits.title: Clear diagnoses
benefits.description: Record and update diagnoses without losing the clinical context.

benefits.title: Safe prescriptions
benefits.description: Keep medication, dosage, frequency, duration, and instructions connected to the visit.

benefits.title: Doctor-scoped access
benefits.description: Clinical records remain restricted to the doctor responsible for the patient.

organized-records.workflowDescription: A visit, its measurements, findings, diagnoses, and medications appear as one complete record in the patient timeline.

appointments.title: A calmer clinic schedule
appointments.description: Manage bookings, patient visits, daily schedules, status changes, and cancellations from a single organized workspace.

benefits.title: Daily overview
benefits.description: See today's appointments and upcoming visits at a glance.

benefits.title: Patient tracking
benefits.description: Open the correct patient file and keep visit context connected.

benefits.title: Conflict-aware booking
benefits.description: Use validated schedules to avoid overlapping appointments.

benefits.title: Responsive updates
benefits.description: Cancel or reschedule appointments while keeping the team informed.

appointments.workflowDescription: Start with the daily schedule, confirm patients, and move smoothly from booking to medical visit.

data-decisions.title: Turn clinic activity into insight
data-decisions.description: Bring visits, appointments, patient activity, and operational trends into a clear dashboard for better decisions.

benefits.title: Patient and visit trends
benefits.description: Understand how the clinic is used over time.

benefits.title: Role-based insight
benefits.description: Doctors and administrators see the information relevant to their responsibilities.

benefits.title: Clear next steps
benefits.description: Use accurate records to prioritize follow-ups and resources.

data-decisions.workflowDescription: Use the dashboard for a concise daily view, then open patient and appointment workflows for details.

connected-team.title: Collaboration with clear responsibilities
connected-team.description: Connect doctors, secretaries, and administrators while keeping sensitive clinical access limited to authorized roles.

benefits.title: Doctor workspace
benefits.description: Doctors manage clinical visits, diagnoses, vitals, and prescriptions.

benefits.title: Secretary workflow
benefits.description: Secretaries manage appointments and approved patient administration.

benefits.title: Admin control
benefits.description: Administrators review accounts and manage active staff roles.

benefits.title: Secure boundaries
benefits.description: Backend authorization prevents secretaries from entering clinical workflows.

connected-team.workflowDescription: Each team member sees the tools needed for their role while patient data stays protected.

Footer.description: A smart platform for organizing medical records and managing the patient journey with confidence.
